title: Stilt area (non-habitable, <2.4 m) used for parking excluded from FAR, counted towards height (plotted residential, clause vii)

citations.original_text: vii. Stilts: If the building is constructed with stilt area of non-habitable height (less than 2.4 m), used for parking, such stilt area shall not be included in FAR but would be counted towards the height of the building.

notes: Re-sourced from the plotted-residential section (page 154, clause vii). The earlier draft mistakenly cited the group-housing clause on page 156. Stilt must be of non-habitable height (<2.4 m) and used for parking; the stilt floor IS counted towards building height.
user_caveat: UBBL gives two stilt heights: clause vii (p.154) says under 2.4 m; 7.15.1 (p.64, as amended in 2017) says at least 2.4 m to the underside of the beam and at most 2.7 m to the underside of the slab. Confirm the stilt height with the sanctioning authority. Used for parking, the stilt still counts towards building height.
